description: One call for "should I buy into a new The Standard Reserve (TSR) charter right now" on Robinhood Chain. Bundles the charter-auction state (1s_std_auctions_current, recent charter-auction days), the license-cost route's cheapest_path (does a license or a whole charter buy the cheaper path to operating a branch right now), Days of Issuance, ETH backing per STANDARD, holder concentration and the genesis-vs-auction cohort split, and any pending governance change affecting charters/day. Each part comes back under parts.<name> with its own status (ok, not_ready, or error); one part failing never fails the whole call. The charter-auction state includes charter.expected_prices: the price path for the rest of the current auction day at +15m, +30m, +1h, +4h and end of day, derived from the measured price and the charter's own half-life (derived; assumes no purchase before then and no parameter changes; rows that would land in the next day are null with a reason). parts.charter_drops_history is history, not a forecast: what one branch counted in each past launchpad charter drop would be worth today. A branch opened now counts toward future drops only.
name: 1s_std_decision_charter
title: TSR Decision: Charter
